title: Amatangazo
description: Ibyo koperative ibwira abanyamuryango bayo, n'inyandiko y'ibyoherejwe.
tableCaption: Amatangazo ya koperative, abo agenewe, imiterere yayo n'umubare w'ubutumwa buri rimwe ryohereje.

filters.searchPlaceholder: Amagambo ari mu izina cyangwa mu butumwa

empty.title: Nta tangazo rihari
empty.body: Andika rimwe umenyeshe abanyamuryango inama, igiciro cyangwa itariki y'itanga. Abenshi bagerwaho kuri SMS aho kuza gufungura iyi paji.

fields.title: Izina
fields.bodyHint: Ibyo abanyamuryango bazasoma. Bigire bigufi: bitwarwa na SMS.
fields.bodyRwHint: Iyo wabwanditse, ni bwo abanyamuryango bahabwa.
fields.audienceHint: Abanyamuryango bagerwaho kuri SMS. Itangazo ry'abakozi risomwa hano muri sisitemu.

form.addDescription: Ribikwa nk'umushinga. Nta kintu kigenda mbere yo kuritangaza.
form.editDescription: Umushinga gusa ushobora guhinduka. Nyuma yo kutangaza, inyandiko igomba kuvuga ibyoherejwe.
form.cost_one: Inyuguti {{characters}}, ubutumwa bumwe kuri buri munyamuryango.

publish.title: Utangaza iri tangazo?
publish.body: Kutangaza rishyira mu nyandiko za koperative. Kohereza kuri SMS ni icyemezo cyihariye.
publish.withoutPhone_one: Umunyamuryango umwe nta nimero ya telefone afite, ntazabona ubu butumwa. Hari uzamubwira.
publish.withoutPhone: Abanyamuryango {{count}} nta nimero ya telefone bafite, ntibazabona ubu butumwa. Hari uzababwira.
publish.cost_one: Ubutumwa bumwe kuri buri wese, bityo {{messages}} muri rusange.
publish.cost: Ubutumwa {{count}} kuri buri wese, bityo {{messages}} muri rusange.
publish.unicode: Inyandiko irimo inyuguti zigabanya ubunini bwa buri butumwa, bityo bihenda kurushaho.
publish.sendSmsHint: Buri butumwa bugira igiciro koperative yishyura. Bisige bidakora utangaze udohereje.
publish.staffOnly: Iri tangazo rigenewe abakozi, bityo risomwa hano kandi nta butumwa bwoherezwa.
publish.mockBody: Nta muyoboro wa SMS urahuzwa. Ibyo wohereza byose byandikwa mu nyandiko y'ubutumwa n'inimero n'inyandiko yabyo, ntacyo kigera kuri telefone.

report.failedBody_one: Ubutumwa bumwe bwanzwe. Inyandiko ivuga uwo munyamuryango n'impamvu.
report.failedBody: Ubutumwa {{count}} bwanzwe. Inyandiko ivuga abo banyamuryango n'impamvu.
report.alreadySent_one: Umunyamuryango umwe yari yamaze koherezwa iri tangazo, ntiryongeye kohereza.
report.alreadySent: Abanyamuryango {{count}} bari bamaze koherezwa iri tangazo, ntiryongeye kohereza.
report.withoutPhone_one: Umunyamuryango umwe nta nimero ya telefone afite, nta kintu yoherejwe.
report.withoutPhone: Abanyamuryango {{count}} nta nimero ya telefone bafite, nta kintu boherejwe.
report.mockBody: Ubu butumwa bwandikwe ntibutangwa, kuko nta muyoboro wa SMS urahuzwa.

archive.title: Ukuraho iri tangazo?
archive.body: Rivamo ku rutonde rukoreshwa rigume mu nyandiko za koperative n'impamvu utanga.
archive.bodySent_one: Ryamaze koherezwa umunyamuryango umwe, utakwibagizwa. Rivamo ku rutonde rukoreshwa rigume mu nyandiko n'impamvu utanga.
archive.bodySent: Ryamaze koherezwa abanyamuryango {{count}}, batakwibagizwa. Rivamo ku rutonde rukoreshwa rigume mu nyandiko n'impamvu utanga.

messages.title: Ubutumwa bwoherejwe
messages.description: Ubutumwa bwose koperative yoherereje abanyamuryango bayo, abo bwagiye n'ibyabaye.
messages.caption: Ubutumwa bwoherejwe, n'umunyamuryango, nimero, inyandiko n'icyavuyemo.

empty.title: Nta kintu cyoherejwe
empty.body: Tangaza itangazo ku banyamuryango, buri butumwa buzagaragara hano n'icyavuyemo.
